query: INSERT INTO board_intent_scan_cursors(project_id, epoch, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(project_id) DO UPDATE SET epoch = excluded.epoch, position = CASE WHEN excluded.epoch = board_intent_scan_cursors.epoch THEN max(board_intent_scan_cursors.position, excluded.position) ELSE excluded.position END WHERE excluded.epoch >= board_intent_scan_cursors.epoch
